
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/hoganben/p/19933055" title="发布于 2026-04-26 18:05">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">安装nessus（使用Kali Linux）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>1.先去网站下载，选择需要的版本和适合自己的机型，这里以Nessus-10.12.0-debian10_amd64.deb为例子。</p>
<p>https://www.tenable.com/downloads/nessus?loginAttempted=true，记得的登陆或者注册一个账号，填写一个有效的注册邮箱，用来接收注册码（免费30天）。</p>
<p><img alt="1777175949099" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1563728/202604/1563728-20260426115941624-1188961885.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;2.安装并配置</p>
<p>在终端以root执行命令，安装</p>
<p>dpkg -i Nessus-10.12.0-debian10_amd64.deb</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">                                                                                                                                                                                                        <br>┌──(root㉿kali)-[/home/gzk/Documents]<br>└─#sudo  dpkg -i Nessus-10.12.0-debian10_amd64.deb 
Selecting previously unselected package nessus.
(Reading database ... 420914 files and directories currently installed.)
Preparing to unpack Nessus-10.12.0-debian10_amd64.deb ...
Unpacking nessus (10.12.0) ...
Setting up nessus (10.12.0) ...
HMAC : (KAT_Integrity) : Pass
HMAC : (Module_Integrity) : Pass
SHA1 : (KAT_Digest) : Pass
SHA2 : (KAT_Digest) : Pass
SHA3 : (KAT_Digest) : Pass
AES_GCM : (KAT_Cipher) : Pass
AES_ECB_Decrypt : (KAT_Cipher) : Pass
RNG : (Continuous_RNG_Test) : Pass
RSA : (KAT_Signature) : Pass
ECDSA : (KAT_Signature) : Pass
ECDSA : (KAT_Signature) : Pass
DSA : (KAT_Signature) : Pass
TLS13_KDF_EXTRACT : (KAT_KDF) : Pass
TLS13_KDF_EXPAND : (KAT_KDF) : Pass
TLS12_PRF : (KAT_KDF) : Pass
PBKDF2 : (KAT_KDF) : Pass
SSHKDF : (KAT_KDF) : Pass
KBKDF : (KAT_KDF) : Pass
HKDF : (KAT_KDF) : Pass
SSKDF : (KAT_KDF) : Pass
X963KDF : (KAT_KDF) : Pass
X942KDF : (KAT_KDF) : Pass
HASH : (DRBG) : Pass
CTR : (DRBG) : Pass
HMAC : (DRBG) : Pass
DH : (KAT_KA) : Pass
ECDH : (KAT_KA) : Pass
RSA_Encrypt : (KAT_AsymmetricCipher) : Pass
RSA_Decrypt : (KAT_AsymmetricCipher) : Pass
RSA_Decrypt : (KAT_AsymmetricCipher) : Pass
        name:           OpenSSL FIPS Provider
        version:        3.1.2
        build:          3.1.2
INSTALL PASSED
Unpacking Nessus Scanner Core Components...

 - You can start Nessus Scanner by typing /bin/systemctl start nessusd.service
 - Then go to https://NESSUS_HOSTNAME_OR_IP:8834/ to configure your scanner
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　查看电脑IP，输入ifconfig查看</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1563728/202604/1563728-20260426120513917-1296136201.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;在浏览器输入&nbsp;https://NESSUS_HOSTNAME_OR_IP:8834/&nbsp; 配置，等待加载点击Continue 继续</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1563728/202604/1563728-20260426120654224-1939172960.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;选择Register for Nessus Essentials，点击Continue</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1563728/202604/1563728-20260426120815395-2130039777.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;填写用户信息以及注册登陆账户的邮箱，点击Register</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1563728/202604/1563728-20260426121624215-657635122.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;点击continue</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1563728/202604/1563728-20260426121736953-1947718041.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>接下来是创建管理员用户和密码，切记拿个小本本记下来。</strong></span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1563728/202604/1563728-20260426121839255-506741310.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;然后等待他的安装和初始化</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1563728/202604/1563728-20260426121944539-493441087.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>等待进入</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1563728/202604/1563728-20260426180504652-39666910.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>此时大功告成，开始体验吧！</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
